description: Open Government portal (Canada) is a data resource listed in Free GIS Data (rtwilson), a curated list of free geographic datasets under the section "Canada", published or maintained by the publisher of open.canada.ca. The list files it under "Canada". The entry links to open.canada.ca. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. It can support infrastructure mapping and planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-free-gis-data-list.
